name: Simple Diagnosis
author: tnomi

sections.description:
This plugin allows you to easily create “diagnostic quizzes” that calculate a score based on questions and choices, then display results depending on the score range. You can create and manage multiple quizzes within your site, and display them on any page using a shortcode. The result field supports HTML, enabling flexible and customizable designs.

Visit The User’s Guide (ja) for more info.
sections.installation:
Installation

  1. Donwload plugin zip file.
  2. Upload plugin file from Administrator menu “Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin”.
  3. Activate the plugin.

Usage

  1. Add a new “Diagnosis” from the WordPress admin menu.
  2. Register your questions, choices with scores, and result ranges.
  3. Insert the shortcode [simpdi id=”72″] into any post or page.
  4. Once published, the quiz form will appear and run entirely on a single page.
